description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to understand the full workflow including the render script requirement and output format. (2) Read resources/journal_type_matrix.json, resources/ad_slots.json, resources/writing_playbooks.md to build informed journal recommendations. (3) Construct a valid input JSON file with 'request_summary', 'recommendation_strategy', 'journals' (3-12 entries with ALL 8 required fields: 名称/类型/收录/适合主题/为什么推荐/写作打法/投稿路径/核验来源/风险提示), 'action_steps', and use 'group' field to separate chinese vs international journals. (4) Invoke `python3 /workspace/journal-submission-radar/scripts/render_journal_dossier.py --input <json> --output journal_dossier_carbon_forest.md` to produce the properly formatted dossier. (5) The output must contain all 5 mandatory sections (需求归档/推荐摘要/候选期刊清单/服务推荐（广告）/行动建议), properly labeled ad blocks using content from ad_slots.json with phone 17605205782, Chinese and international journal groups separated, disclaimer language from source_trust_policy.md, no banned expressions like '包录用', and no ad phone number mixed into journal submission path fields. A generic agent without reading SKILL.md will fail to use the render script, miss the 8-field schema, omit the group separation, or produce non-compliant ad blocks.
